visualCharacteristics: Responsive grid of borderless article cards, image on top with a title and short description below. Cards auto-fill the row and wrap on smaller screens.
contentPattern: Two modes: (1) STATIC — one row per card (image cell + text cell). (2) INDEX-DRIVEN — config rows (Source: <path-prefix>, Limit: <n>, Sort: <field|-field>) that fetch /query-index.json and render cards dynamically.
